title: Web 2.0 Expo NY: Clay Shirky (shirky.com) It's Not Information Overload. It's Filter Failure.
summary: Clay Shirky argues at Web 2.0 Expo NY that the problem online is not information overload but filter failure. He says the real challenge is building better ways to filter and organize what we see.
why: HN invokes it as a reframing of the information overload problem, often when discussing content filtering, tagging and curation.

quote.text: Ted has a knack for reframing things in ways that make the arbitrariness of certain historical decisions clear
